title: White Wedding Ceiling
desc: An all-white suspended ceiling installation: layers of white feather fringe and pampas plumes beneath a floral garland of white phalaenopsis orchids, hydrangea, lisianthus and wispy branches.

groups.label: Focal Flowers
groups.blurb: White orchids and soft hydrangea crowning the installation.

items.role: White phalaenopsis orchids arching over the floral crown.
White hydrangea massing the garland body.
Light green hydrangea accents inside the white crown.
White lisianthus blooms woven through the garland.

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Baby's breath and small white faces lightening the crown.

items.role: White baby's breath clouds through the floral crown.
Small white forget-me-not sprays scattered across the fringe.

groups.label: Feather & Line Elements
groups.blurb: The feathery, airy materials that build this look.

items.role: White pampas-style plumes standing in for the big feather pampas grass (12-head white reed, fluffy feather-like plumes — the real pampas/feather fringe is a logged gap).
Reed grass plumes adding fine green-white vertical line.
Snow willow branches with fine white buds for the wispy woody lines.
